Easy, Intuitive ABA Therapy Billing Software

Rethink’s billing software saves your ABA therapy practice time & money by increasing efficiency and automation with customized workflow integrations.

Request A Demo

Overview of our Billing Software

RethinkBH’s comprehensive software allows providers and groups to seamlessly streamline clinical, scheduling and practice management data preventing scheduling and billing errors that may impact payments.

Features & Benefits

Scheduling & Billing Synchronization

Seamless controls prevent coding and scheduling errors that impact payments. Get reimbursed on time, every time.

Easy Report Exporting

Payroll and billing reports can be exported and shared amongst clinicians or parents.

Business Integrity & Accountability

Rethink provides transparent contract utilization through our client portal to ensure members receive the care their families pay for.

Tracking & Compliance

Funder contracts , rates, billing codes, and parent signatures are housed in one central location. Never lose track of any important financial information and maintain compliance.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is RethinkBH Billing Software?

RethinkBH Billing Software is an integrated billing solution specifically designed for ABA and pediatric therapy practices. It combines scheduling, clinical data, and billing into one unified platform to automate claims, reduce denials, and accelerate payments, streamlining your practice’s operations.

What features are included with the software?

The RethinkBH Billing Software offers several robust features, including:

  • Scheduling & Billing Synchronization: Prevents common coding and scheduling errors that can directly impact payments.
  • Automated Claim Submission: Automatically generates and efficiently submits claims directly from your session data.
  • Easy Report Exporting: Allows for the simple and quick export of crucial payroll and billing reports.
  • Real-time Status Tracking: Keeps your revenue moving by providing real-time tracking of all claim statuses.
  • Automated (Electronic Remittance Advice) ERA Posting: Reconciles payments in mere seconds with its efficient automatic ERA uploads.
What are the key benefits of using this software?

Key benefits of using RethinkBH Billing Software include:

  • Faster payments: By automating claims submission and significantly reducing denials, the software helps shorten the reimbursement cycle.
  • Improved accuracy: It utilizes built-in payor rules and comprehensive validations to identify and flag errors before claims are even submitted, ensuring cleaner claims.
  • Improved efficiency: By automating the reconciliation process it saves administrative time.
Is there a free trial or version of the software?

There is no free trial or version of RethinkBH. You can request a demo to see a full version of the RethinkBH Billing Software.

How does the software reduce claim denials?

RethinkBH Billing Software significantly reduces claim denials by employing built-in payor rules and comprehensive validations. These tools work in real-time to identify and flag potential errors or discrepancies before a claim is even submitted, ensuring a higher rate of first-pass acceptance.

How does the software help save time and money for a practice?

The software significantly increases efficiency and automation by providing customized workflow integrations. It eliminates manual, duplicate data entry by automatically generating claims directly from session data and further automates payment reconciliation with ERA uploads. This results in less administrative work and quicker revenue cycles.

Can I integrate RethinkBH with my current billing system?

Yes. RethinkBH offers flexible integrations with existing billing systems while also providing a built-in billing solution to streamline claims submission and payment workflows.
